nary_nodes.label: Russian attack on Kyiv
evidence: Ukraine’s capital Kyiv came under a deadly Russian attack early Monday morning, on the eve of a critical NATO summit in Turkey that US President Donald Trump plans to attend.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event describing an act of aggression or assault, typically involving violence.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No suitable schema.org event type for attacks; minting AttackEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Ukrainian strike on Russian oil refinery
evidence: On Monday, the Ukrainian military said it struck Russia’s largest oil refinery, in a long range strike more than 2,500 kilometres from the Ukrainian border.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing a work stoppage or coordinated attack, often involving collective action.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No appropriate schema.org type for strikes; minting StrikeEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Power outages in Ukraine
evidence: Monday’s attacks led to power outages across a number of regions in Ukraine, including Kyiv, Sumy, Kharkiv and Dnipropetrovsk, the country’s electricity transmission agency said.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event describing a loss of electrical power supply in a specific area.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No suitable schema.org type for power outages; minting PowerOutageEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Evacuation of residents in Kyiv
evidence: Rescuers evacuated residents, including children, from the upper floors of a damaged building in the district early Monday , while many in the capital spent hours in air raid shelters.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event involving the organized relocation of people from a dangerous area.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No appropriate schema.org type for evacuations; minting EvacuationEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky on Putin timing
evidence: “This is typical of Putin: right after America’s Independence Day and before the NATO Summit in Ankara,” Zelensky said Sunday in a post on X ahead of the attack.

nary_nodes.label: Ukrainian air force on missile interceptions
evidence: None of the ballistic missiles fired at Ukraine on Monday were shot down by air defenses, according to data from its air force, which said 29 ballistic missiles and 18 attack drones had struck 34 locations across the country.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky warning of new massive strike
evidence: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky had warned just hours earlier that Moscow was “preparing a new massive strike,” and the fresh assault comes just days after a ferocious Russian attack on Kyiv killed 30 people last Thursday – the third-deadliest attack on the capital since the war began.

nary_nodes.label: UN HRMM on civilian casualties
evidence: Civilian casualties in 2026 are “significantly higher” than during the same period in 2025, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine said in a Monday statement.

nary_nodes.label: Russian defense ministry on weapons used
evidence: Russia’s defense ministry said it used “high‑precision, long‑range weapons” to target military‑industrial facilities and fuel and energy sites in Kyiv on Monday.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky on interceptor missile shortage
evidence: The “insufficient supply of interceptor missiles” was the reason Ukraine was unable to shoot down any ballistic missiles in Monday’s assault, Zelensky said in a statement.

nary_nodes.label: Ursula von der Leyen on air defence need
evidence: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said that the country “urgently needs more air defence. We will discuss it this week in Ankara at the @NATO Summit.”

nary_nodes.label: Trump offer to end war
evidence: Trump then offered again to help end the war on Sunday during a nearly 90‑minute call with Russian President Vladimir Putin, according to Russia’s foreign ministry.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky plea for Patriot missiles
evidence: Ahead of the summit, Zelensky is using the attacks on Kyiv to renew his plea for allies to supply Ukraine with missiles for Patriot systems.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky on Patriots effectiveness
evidence: Zelensky sees Patriots as key for shooting down Russia’s arsenal of ballistic missiles, loitering munitions and increasingly its Geran‑4 jet‑powered drones –– which fly too fast for Kyiv’s mobile fire groups and can only be shot down with ground‑to‑air missiles or fighter jets.

nary_nodes.label: Russian push for Donetsk
evidence: Russian forces have also stepped up efforts to take more of Ukraine’s eastern Donetsk region – a key objective for the Kremlin, and Ukraine’s cities face near‑nightly attacks from Moscow’s drones and missiles.

nary_nodes.label: Ukraine attacks on Russian infrastructure
evidence: Ukraine, meantime, has also recently ramped up missile and drone attacks against key infrastructure deep inside Russian territory, including oil refineries, ports and military factories.

nary_nodes.label: Russia shot down Ukrainian drones
evidence: Russia shot down 519 Ukrainian drones launched toward it overnight into Monday, the state news agency TASS reported.

nary_nodes.label: Klitschko on city damage
evidence: There was “destruction and damage” in four districts of the city, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said, adding that the Podilsky district was hit the hardest.

nary_nodes.label: Ukrainian military on oil refinery strike
evidence: On Monday, the Ukrainian military said it struck Russia’s largest oil refinery, in a long range strike more than 2,500 kilometres from the Ukrainian border.
